blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — The Oklahoma City Thunder will retire the number “0” jersey of star guard Russell Westbrook at a February 7 home game against New York, the NBA club announced on Monday. The 37-year-old guard announced his retirement in August after 18 NBA seasons in which he became the all-time league leader in triple doubles with 209. Westbrook spent 11 seasons with the Thunder from 2008-2019 and had stints with Houston, Washington, the Los Angeles Clippers and Los Angeles Lakers, Denver and Sacramento.
